description:
## 1.36.0-dev.105 (2026-08-10)

- Reddit: isolate comment selection from Android focus so preview key release remains on the established pre-dev100 path.
- Reddit: restore native comment-list entry when K or I is first pressed in post detail.
- Reddit: make O invoke only the selected comment's native Collapse or Expand action.
- Reddit: clear comment selection on post exit and use a subtler selection outline.
